name: EZ Bar Reverse Curl
steps: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold an EZ bar in front of your thighs with an overhand palms-down grip on the outer angles.
Tuck your elbows close to your sides and brace your core.
Curl the bar upward toward your shoulders while keeping your palms facing down and wrists neutral.
Lower the bar slowly back to arm's length with full control.
tips: Keep your wrists straight rather than letting them bend backward as your forearms tire.
Avoid swinging your shoulders or using torso momentum to lift the weight.
